title: Niagara Takes Flight with Walking Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Join a fun and informative walking tour of Niagara Falls, finishing off with a ticket to Niagara's newest attraction, Niagara Takes Flight.

Meet your guide and set out on a 30-minute walk, learning about the facts and stories of this magical natural wonder. Hear stories of the daredevils who challenged the falls and learn about the origin of the falls, all while getting an up-close experience.

Enjoy an intimate, smaller group tour, giving you more opportunity to ask questions and stop along the way for that perfect photograph. Come away from this tour with great memories and a deeper understanding of this wondrous place.

End with the experience of virtually riding over the falls on this new and amazing attraction at Niagara Parks, Ontario.
